mission: Guardrails as code and ops runbooks in GitHub Actions (owner request 2026-10-15): agents in cloud sessions run data-lane reads and owner-gated writes through allowlisted workflow_dispatch runbooks and never see a secret; committed Claude Code settings and hook; hold-for-owner merge hold; signed-out web smoke after deliveries; intake/reporting templates. Staging only; no collector, setting, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no deploy, enqueue or runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: New workflow_dispatch-only workflows, staging ref only, no pull_request trigger. ops-readonly runs allowlisted read-only runbooks with the staging-delivery Environment's existing read credentials; every database session is default_transaction_read_only=on on a fingerprinted staging connection. ops-write waits for the owner in a new staging-ops Environment (required reviewer, holds no secret) before its runbook job gets credentials; dry run by default; quiet windows and running deliveries are checked at dispatch and again before the runbook. Nothing runs until someone dispatches it; this PR dispatches nothing.

CI: staging-pr-live treats a PR labelled hold-for-owner as not current, so it is never armed (owner merges by hand); after the existing delivery verification, staging-automerge, the reusable delivery workflow and Verify staging merge run the read-only signed-out web smoke and add its receipt to the artifact; agent-state-tests gains a Postgres 16 service and runs the guardrail, ops-runbook and web-smoke tests. No secret, variable, environment, provider or production destination changes; arming, merge window and rollout logic otherwise unchanged.

Read-only ops tooling moved from the session 13 handoff tools (db, storage rates, lossless verify, fleet vs receipt, re-plan, approved list) plus official-images status, named diagnostics SQL and the web smoke. The only write path is the existing PR #116 enqueue tool behind ops-write (owner approval, dry run default, apply only with the reviewed list SHA-256). scripts/ is not installed in any image: 0 collector runtime inputs (scripts/product_lane.py import-graph check, SNKRDUNK and Yuyu-Tei).

Claude Code project settings and a PreToolUse hook for agent sessions: deny the Railway CLI, remote psql/pg_dump, printing the environment, owner-approval signals, GitHub deployments/environments/rulesets/branch-protection/secrets APIs, direct pushes to staging and force pushes; block Edit/Write on DATA-lane paths (scripts/product_lane.path_reason) unless CARDPIRATE_LANE=data. Agent tooling only; no runtime, CI credential or auth change. Tightens agent permissions; does not change the security or secrets policy.

Guardrail hook tests (exit 2 on every blocked class, allowed commands pass, lane agrees with product_lane), ops runbook tests (session 13 storage rates reproduced from committed evidence, quiet windows, delivery check, secret scan, read-only diagnostics on a real schema with a refused write), web smoke decision rules.

Agent task issue form, PR template (plain summary, lane, verification, staging URL, owner check), root CLAUDE.md (lanes, local tests, runbooks, GitHub REST notes, hard lines; links the policy), AUTONOMY_POLICY.md cloud-session section (what agents may do alone, what stays the owner's), OPS_RUNBOOKS.md, STAGING_DELIVERY.md owner hold and web smoke.

impact.deployment_impact: Workflow, tooling, tests and docs only. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes; scripts/, .github/ and .claude/ are not installed in any image. api_sha=merge accepts a skipped API build; web redeploys through Vercel Git with no app change.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the ops workflows, guard hook and settings, the hold-label check and the web smoke step, restoring the previous CI exactly. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo; the staging-ops Environment and hold-for-owner label are inert without the workflows.
recovery.trigger: Arming of a PR that carries hold-for-owner, or a non-held ready PR no longer arming; web smoke failing on a healthy site; agent-state-tests red from the new suites; any ops runbook output containing a secret or a database session that is not read-only.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After the owner's hand merge: Verify staging merge receipt with the web smoke OK; one ops-readonly staging-state run and one official-images-status run succeed with read-only sessions, and their summaries are attached to this PR.
